name: @wildshard/wire
description: The Wildshard wire contract and frozen compatibility baseline.

scripts.check: pnpm build && git diff --exit-code -- lib && test -z "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- lib)" && node --check bin.mjs && node --check src/version.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --noEmit && oxfmt -c ../../src/.oxfmtrc.json --check bin.mjs src test cli && node bin.mjs check --baseline
